vaultoPolicy: A deposit limit of 0 or a stale NAV → DEFER (temporarily paused, waiting NAV refresh), not REJECT.

Direct contract builds only as a fallback when the IXS MCP fails for a non-safety reason, and never when the deposit-limit or NAV checks fail. In Replay (a past block, simulation only) calldata is encoded directly because the MCP builds against the current state only.
No mock tokens or mock vaults: only the vaults listed by the IXS Vault API and the asset their contracts report through asset().

A NAV older than 72 h, or older than the contract's navStalenessThreshold(), is treated as stale.

sections.heading: Treasury condition
sections.body: The treasury totals 1,984,529 USD, all idle, with 23 idle days. Asset mix is 1,042,009.20 USD in BTC and 942,520 USD in USDC, and current BTC exposure is 53%, which remains below the 70% cap.

sections.heading: Policy
sections.body: Policy guardrails require a 30% liquidity floor, a 70% maximum asset exposure, and a minimum vault risk score of 80. Live mode is opt-in only; when enabled, it is capped per transaction by the guardrail and requires the wallet's signature. Live redeemable minimum: ixv1 ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03) = 104 USDC, which keeps the whole position redeemable above the 100 USDC net minimum after the 0.5% redeem fee with a 3% NAV buffer.

sections.heading: Proposed allocation
sections.body: Allocate 572,000 USDC to IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB on BNB Chain. This is a simulated recommendation, not an on-chain movement; the vault is deployed, active, open to the wallet, has an unlimited deposit limit, and meets the 100 USDC minimum. The planner projects liquidity at 71%, blended yield at 0.9%, health score at 85, and extra monthly income of about 1,463 USD.

sections.heading: Deferred (waiting NAV refresh)
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh because the deposit limit is 0 USDC and NAV is stale at 10.4 days old. It unblocks when NAV is refreshed and the deposit limit becomes nonzero.

sections.heading: Rejected
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB · Licensed is rejected because the wallet is not whitelisted, the deposit limit is 0 USDC, and NAV is stale. BTC Real Yield is rejected because it is announced but not deployed.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: Key risks are RWA credit risk, the daily redemption cycle, the 0.5% redemption fee, NAV drift between updates, and smart-contract plus counterparty risk. For async vaults, requests are processed at the next 17:00 SGT cutoff on Singapore business days, with settlement estimated about one business day later; sync vaults mint shares in the deposit transaction.
